acceptance: After the deprecation window set by ADR D13, the clickhouse `mode` alias and the `embedded` synonym are rejected with an error naming the manifest selector, in the CLI, MCP and saved configs
Docs and CHANGELOG record the removal
context: Updated 2026-10-09: the ClickHouse `mode` alias is now one of several deployment aliases that core-exec-deployment-selection-recorded routes through the manifest selector (ADR docs/development/adr/adr-core-execution-variants.md D12/D13). Remove it together with the other deprecated execution-variant aliases in core-exec-remove-deprecated-aliases after the deprecation window; if that item covers it, close this one as superseded with a pointer.
description:
Promoted from deferral #575 of standardize-clickhouse-deployment-mode-contract.
Deferred: Remove the legacy `mode` alias and `embedded` synonym entirely after one deprecation window
Reason deferred: Current callers and old config files may still depend on these spellings; this TODO should normalize reads and canonicalize writes first
